Thank you for reaching out to us about the issue with our app crashing on your iPhone. I'm here to help you troubleshoot the problem.

Based on our troubleshooting FAQ, I recommend trying the following steps:

1. Force-close the app and reopen it.
2. Check for updates to ensure you have the latest version from the app store.
3. Restart your device to clear any temporary issues.
4. If the issue persists, reinstall the app (your data is stored in the cloud and will sync after login).

If none of these steps resolve the issue, please report the problem to us with your device model, OS version (iOS 17.5), and app version number. We'll do our best to assist you further.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation. I look forward to hearing back from you.
